text:
raj: Heads-up — kicking off a role-firebreak cleanup across prod projects. Goal: remove unused iam:roles/admin and tighten KMS cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter bindings. Need quick triage on evidence collection and rollback plan. @lisa @maria
lisa: SG. I can pull last-auth logs + key usage heatmap. Will run an export for 90d and sample owners.
maria: I can help with svcacct sampling and a small RBAC canary. Question: do we treat 'dataplane-admin' as admin or platform role for this cleanup?
raj: Treat as platform unless it has wide-scope perms. If it has project-level admin perms, include in prune.
alex: ran a quick query and found ~24 svcaccts with admin bindings but no activity in 60d. Query:
```
# BigQuery export
SELECT principal, role, COUNT(*) as hits
FROM `redwood.audit_logs.iam_binding_events`
WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY principal, role
ORDER BY hits ASC
LIMIT 100;
```
lisa: Nice. I'll produce a 'heatmap.csv' and flag keys with >1 unused admin binding.
sec-bot: Audit export finished: /tmp/iam_export_1723459999.tar.gz (sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef)
maria: For KMS, FYI last rotation policy is OK; but some keys have broad members. Suggest: create key-level ACL sheet and propose temporary deny for candidates before removal.
raj: Agreed. Plan: 1) owners + service contact notify 48h 2) apply deny for 24h as canary 3) remove binding if no impact 4) record in ticket and snapshot logs. Who does denies?
lisa: I can push denies in-stage and monitor logs. Will prepare rollback playbook.
alex: +1. I'll draft the ticket with affected principals and KMS key fingerprints.
raj: Great. Action items: lisa->deny rollout, alex->ticket, maria->svcacct list, raj->comms. Check-in at EOD. :thumbsup:
